# MAC-010 — IMF 2022 Article IV Mexico — Chapter 5B Routing Decision

## Source-Level Decision

**INCLUDE** MAC-010 for the AMLO 2022 Chapter 5B dossier. The IMF Article IV is a high-authority international-organization report that comments directly on Mexico's 2022 macro-fiscal mix, monetary–fiscal stance, structural reform agenda, energy policy, labor market reforms, financial sector, and DM-DEG governance indicators — all of which map onto the 5B evidence lenses despite the navigation map being frozen. Use authority notes once per chunk.

## Authoritative Phase-1 Exclusions

**Reason for skipping phases:** The frozen navigation map contains no embedded likely_question_ids, topics, actors, periods, or table_locators; I therefore cannot pre-classify, and routing against the unfilled templates would be fabricated routing. The single-document shape (one PDF, deterministic fanned pages) means each chunk is evaluated independently on its own text against the 5B lenses, not against prior phase outputs.

## Per-Chunk Routing (5B lenses: 1 prosperity agenda • 2 econ-team quality • 3 macro rules • 4 fair market rules • 5 anti-corruption enforcement • 6 budget quality • 7 reliable info/correction • 8 distributional incidence • 9 shock response • 10 durable trajectory)

Pages below are the original PDF page numbers (1–104); the chunk's `locator` field is off by one versus the body header (e.g., U0001 "page 1" = title page).

## Summary

- **INCLUDED** chunks: U0002–U0006, U0008–U0068, U0069–U0105, U0107–U0108, U0110–U0114.
- **EXCLUDED** chunks (auditable): U0007 (table of contents only), U0109 (World Bank link only), U0106 (informational annex cover). Total 3 chunks excluded for being navigational/structural rather than substantive; no chunks excluded for a 5B-relevance mismatch, because the IMF Article IV body is broadly on-topic for an economic-wellbeing (5B) dossier even when individual pages are predominately monetary or data-quality in focus.
- **Adjacent context to record** for every INCLUDED chunk: source `MAC-010` (IMF 2022 Article IV Mexico, Report No. 22/334, published Nov 2022, mission Sep 12–23 2022), publication_date `unknown_not_recorded` per registry but document dated October 18, 2022 staff report / November 2022 publication; covers AMLO's full 2022 calendar year and the 2023 budget proposal (Box 1).
- **Specificity note for 5B.2 (economic-team quality)**: Cabinet roster is named in U0006, U0107, U0108 — Finance Secretary Ramírez de la O, Banxico Governor Rodríguez Ceja, Labor Secretary Alcalde, Economy Secretary Clouthier — providing direct evidence for the 5B.2 lens. Other chunks reference Banxico's institutional conduct more than individual appointments.
- **5B.7 (reliable information / correction)**: U0002–U0003 describe Banxico's communication improvements; U0021–U0022 + Annex X cover fiscal-framework transparency; U0100–U0112 cover data adequacy and tax-administration effectiveness.
- **5B.5 (anti-corruption enforcement)**: U0003, U0034, U0035, U0039, U0064, U0085, U0098, U0100, U0012 (Pemex supplier debt) — systematic coverage but no IMF-investigated corruption cases.

End of routing decision.
